title.narrative: Sustainable Energy Access in Eastern Indonesia — Electricity Grid Development Program (Phase 2)

description.narrative: SEAEI is a multi-year initiative with a series of interrelated lending programs and projects in Eastern Indonesia covering power generation, transmission, and distribution.3 The SEAEI— Electricity Grid Development Program, approved in 2017, covers the regions of Sulawesi and Nusa Tenggara (Phase 1).4 Phase 2 will cover the remaining regions of Eastern Indonesia, namely Kalimantan, Maluku, and Papua. The program aims to enhance access to sustainable and modern energy services in the target regions as envisioned in PLN's Electricity Power Supply Business Plan (RUPTL), 2019-2028, which will improve connectivity and help the regions' response to coronavirus disease (COVID-19) impacts.5 The program also addresses a key priority of the government's National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) 2020-2024 to stimulate more inclusive growth with a focus on Eastern Indonesia.

Output: Institutional capacity strengthened and social monitoring enhanced. Indicator: E-procurement and SAP systems are integrated and implemented by 2020, and at least 80% of contracts in financial value are recorded in the e-procurement-SAP integrated system by 2024. (2018 baseline: E-procurement and SAP systems are separate) DLI 8 Achievement: 46.35 Progress/Status: 31.85% of contracts in financial value are recorded. There were differences between PLN's calculation and IVA's verification result due to several factors: IVA filtered the E-procurement data to include only UID/UIWs under the KMP RBL and headquarters covering data from 2023-2025 as the maximum contract period from PLN is only 2 years, and IVA did a coherent check to ensure that the matching identifiers (e.g. vendor name and procurement number) are from the same row in both SAP and E-proc entries.
Field verification mission revealed that low number of staff interviewed were aware of the integrated E-proc and SAP launched by PLN HQ, did not understand and implement the SOP on this integrated system and not aware of urgency to implement this system. The Mission suggested that PLN can conduct more frequent socialization and regular (quarterly) check-ups by appointing a dedicated team to closely monitor the users' understanding, SOP implementation, and compliance with the integrated system.
The above updates were confirmed during the 2025 interim Jan-June loan review mission at the end of Oct 2025.
Data Source: E-procurement plus SAP integrated system
